entry.title: The Universe of Inverted Tori
entry.summary: A speculative essay asking whether one universe-instance is the Möbius seam itself: a globally twisted torus bundle whose locally ordinary toroidal slices return orientation-reversed, distributing a Prime Being's residue without reversing time or manufacturing antimatter.

entry.title: The Zero-Seam Test — A Little Red Dots Research Proposal
entry.summary: A preregistered, staged research programme for testing whether JWST little red dots contain evidence for a TTI integration front or an inherited residue from an orientation-reversed minus-one-to-zero sector.

entry.title: JWST’s Little Red Dots, Through TTI
entry.summary: A disciplined TTI speculation: JWST's little red dots as residues of a previous universe or of the hidden interval from minus one to zero, emerging as compact integration seams in the young cosmos.

entry.title: The Residue That Did Not Meet Its Opposite
entry.summary: A speculative essay asking whether visible matter is the unmatched residue of an earlier interaction, while complementary antimatter survives in an orthogonal, periodically overlapping, or quasiperiodic phase sector.

entry.title: Temporal Antipodes — The Two Infinities Out of Time
entry.summary: A disciplined TTI conjecture that the smallward and largeward infinities occupy opposite temporal asymptotes and therefore cannot fully synchronise, although finite projections may overlap in phase.

entry.title: The One Residue That Travels
entry.summary: A speculative philosophy of time proposing one Prime Being per universe-instance: every being could occupy that role in another instance, while one residue is transmitted through each spacetime and distributed as many philosophical ideas.
